usedFor: New Pipedrive deals are copied into HubSpot as deals.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deal” in Pipedrive, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot

watchOut: In reverse, “When a deal is created or updated” fires on edits, so “Create Person” can run twice.
